Players Committee card image of [[Sith Probe Droid (V) (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), a retired Virtual Modern card (Virtual Set 0).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithprobedroid.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 ab74419] (31 July 2022). the PC now serves the DRK-1 (Dark Eye Probe Droid) image under this file name (since 30 December 2024).

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
